name: Accountant

Job duties are primarily bookkeeping rather than professional accounting
Canadian designation not properly documented
Role is financial analysis rather than accounting

name: Architect

Job duties don't involve building design

Detail building design and planning responsibilities
Include project examples demonstrating architectural work

name: Computer Systems Analyst
description: Computer Systems Analysts design and implement computer systems to meet business needs. This has become the primary TN category for tech workers displaced from the Engineer category after the June 2025 USCIS policy change. Note: pure programmers do NOT qualify.
commonDenialReasons: Job duties describe pure programming rather than systems analysis
No evidence of designing or implementing business systems
Job title doesn't align with systems analysis work
Degree not related to computer systems
employerLetterTips: Emphasize systems analysis, design, and implementation duties
Describe how the role evaluates business requirements and designs solutions
Avoid listing pure coding or programming as primary duties
Show the role involves analyzing organizational needs, not just writing code
juneUpdate: This category has seen increased applications since June 2025 as tech workers displaced from the Engineer category seek alternatives. USCIS is scrutinizing CSA applications more closely — ensure job duties clearly describe systems analysis, not programming.

name: Disaster Relief Insurance Claims Adjuster

Insufficient documentation of 3 years experience and training completion

name: Economist
description: Economists study the production and distribution of resources, goods, and services by collecting and analyzing data, researching trends, and evaluating economic issues. The June 2025 USCIS update narrowed this category significantly.

Degree is in finance or business rather than economics
Job duties don't involve economic research or analysis
Title says 'Economist' but work is consulting or data analytics

Reference economic theories, models, or methodologies used
Distinguish from financial analysis, market research, or data analytics
Show the role requires applying economic principles

name: Engineer

Detail how the role applies engineering principles and methodology

juneUpdate: CRITICAL: As of June 2025, USCIS requires credentials in a recognized engineering discipline. Computer Science degrees no longer qualify. Software developers without an engineering degree or PE/P.Eng license should apply under Computer Systems Analyst instead.
